Row.Text: "You once laid siege to Ba Sing Se for 600 days, but it would not yield to you."
"There's no war in Ba Sing Se."
"The city is called Ba Sing Se. It's the impenetrable city. They don't call it Na Sing Se. That means penetrable city."
